title: Update V3.0.1 Patchnotes
newFeatures: Added Accuracy Labels to countdowns, tap one to see what it means
Added the ability to pin events
Reworked "More Info" sections to add more info
Click any countdown to open its More Info
Time changes now show what it was, what it is now and the difference
Added Ability to share individual events
Added automatic countdown updating and background refreshing
Announcements now appear and disappear live
Ended events show how long ago they ended and fade out
Events with no date show "No date known yet"
Smarter section layout that fills empty gaps
Redesigned OBS Mode and added previewer
Redesigned Widgets to work on other websites
bugFixes: Addressed Lag Issues on lower end devices
removals: Removed Ability to tweet from website
